posts.text: I am happy to share that I will be starting a student position at Canada Life as a Software Developer! I am excited to grow my skills, take on new challenges, and contribute to impactful projects with a great team. Thank you to the Canada Life team, including Anne Thea Ocampo and Jodi Lammiman, for the support and opportunity!

I had an incredible time at the Women in Science and Engineering National Conference hosted by Women in Science and Engineering (WISE) University of Toronto Chapter in January! It was an amazing opportunity to connect with like-minded individuals and hear inspiring stories from women in STEM. One of the highlights was participating in the Qualcomm AR Case Competition alongside my fantastic teammates Danica Peltier, Raisa Kayastha, and Yukta Mehta.
